exposure: Organophosphorus (OP) pesticide metabolites (DEDTP and others) in maternal urine during the third trimester
cohort: Pregnant women from an agricultural region in Jordan and their newborns.
finding: Exposure to the OP metabolite DEDTP during pregnancy was negatively correlated with gestational age and Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes, but other OP metabolites showed no significant associations with newborn anthropometric characteristics.
